mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, status, FROM unit_of_measure ORDER BY ${q.orderBy} LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unit_of_measure
SELECT id, code, name, description, status, FROM unit_of_measure WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, code, name, description, status, FROM unit_of_measure WHERE name = #{name} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, code, name, description, status, FROM unit_of_measure WHERE (code = #{v} OR name = #{v}) AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO unit_of_measure (code, name, description, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (CONCAT('TMP-', UUID_SHORT()), #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE unit_of_measure SET code = CONCAT('DVD', IF(id < 1000, LPAD(id, 3, '0'), id)) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE unit_of_measure SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE unit_of_measure SET deleted = 1, updated_by = #{by}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0

mapper.sql: p.id, p.code, p.name, p.sort_order, p.description, p.color, p.status, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_by, p.updated_at, p.version, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kpi k WHERE k.perspective_id = p.id AND k.deleted = 0) AS kpi_count
